sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
major maintenance procedures P1, which must 
be performed every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title block.

ال
low pressure steam turbine by-pass valve is a station for reduction the steam 
pressure and temperature outlets from the main steam of low pressure steam 
boiler to very low pressure and temperature which be able to get in the 
condenser.
المواصفات الفنية

The first draft 
is initiated by eng. Mohamed Abdel Azeem, tested by eng. Essam Darwish, reviewed 
by eng. Ahmed Fathy, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng 
Samir Abd El Gilil; approved by general 
director eng. Mohamed Anan and accepted by 
eng. Mohamed Elsarrag head sector of 
Demiatta PS.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director, and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precaution

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs etc.
Shut down the unit.

Isolate the by-pass valve mechanically and 
 electrically.

Remove the actuator by the crane.

sections.text: تقتيش

Inspect the cracks in the valve interior. If there, remove them by grinding 
 and recheck with fluid penetrate test (the limit ل
 cracks is 3 mm).

Remove by lapping with cast iron disc any small impressions in the seat 
 sealing surface resulting from clamped-in foreign particles.

تحقق من التآكل داخل الصمام. إذا كان هناك، قم بإزالته عن طريق التنظيف بدون 
 المنتجات المسببة للتآكل أو عن طريق اللف بقرص من الحديد الزهر.

Inspect the valve seat, if there is any damages or cracks, retreat it by 
 grinding or machining.
Replace the valve seat if it cannot be reconditioning.
Check the valve bonnet for damages and treat it by grinding or machining.
Inspect packing (13) and replace it if required.
Replace the stuffing box (14) in case of leakage.
Replace the stem guide (8) if it is required.
Put a new gasket (6) in the spray nozzle.
استبدل العبوة (5.5) في فوهة الرش إذا لزم الأمر.
Clean all parts before assembly.
Change the plug.

sections.text: حَشد
Install the plug (12) in bonnet (7).
Install the stem guide (8) in bonnet (7).

Insert new stem packing rings (14).
 ►Do not overfill gland with packing rings. Leave at least height of one ring 
 free to accept gland bush (15).

Insert gland bush (15), gland nut (16) and snap ring (17). Tighten gland nut 
 slightly.
 ► Do not over tighten the gland nut.

Secure stem from dropping through packing box by inserting a pin through the 
 hole in the stem.

Lift the complete bonnet assembly with the stem / plug and slide it carefully 
 into the valve body.

Inspect pressure seal gasket.
 ►تأكد من ضبط الجذع / القابس بدقة على مقعد الصمام.
Insert spacer ring (20) and segment (19).
Mount cover plate (18).
Screw the bolts (21).
قم بتركيب مقرن المشغل عن طريق البراغي (22) ثم قم بإحكام ربطها.
